# Live Region

Announcing a change, to a region that was already being listened to.

In `library/components/live-region/` — copy `component.{html,css,js}`, read `docs.md` for why.

## ARIA

- **polite** — `role=status`
- **assertive** — `role=alert`
- **append-only** — `role=log`

## Goes wrong when

- the region injected already holding its text, so nothing changed after it was observed
- display:none on the region, which is not in the tree to change
- cleared and set in the same tick, which is reported as one state
- one requestAnimationFrame — it runs before paint, so both writes still batch
- aria-live written by hand instead of the role, losing aria-atomic and the name
- assertive for anything merely important, rather than for what stops being useful in seconds

## API

- `AC.createAnnouncer(options) -> { announce, element, assertiveElement, destroy }`
- `AC.speak(el, text)`

WCAG 1.4.1 3.3.1 4.1.3 · [APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/live-regions/) · see also `status-text`, `notice`, `loading-button`
